File Lock The file is locked and cannot be opened again during this execution of this run unit' and C/F performing label processing ('the labels are processed according to the implementor's standard label convention'). §2023:14.9.6.4 GR3 keeps the table (Table 14) and symbols a, b, d, f, g, but has no WITH LOCK row or file-lock symbol (the §2023:14.9.6.2 general format offers only REEL/UNIT [FOR REMOVAL] or WITH NO REWIND, so CLOSE WITH LOCK is refused), reduces c) to 'Closing operations specified by the implementor are executed' with no label processing, drops the label procedures from e), and adds that a CLOSE UNIT of the last unit sets the file position indicator to no next record.
